theme: An open day with two things quietly waiting.
greeting: Nothing is on the calendar today, Dan, and the girls are at Jen's. A wide-open Friday that leaves room for the two things that have been sitting a while.

needsAttention.title: Valoris is waiting on your read
needsAttention.detail: Martin sent their comments on your proposal and a draft confidentiality and non-compete for the evaluation period; you told him you'd look and come back. He's offered a call on either when you're ready.

needsAttention.title: December trip is past its book-by
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist-and-book call for the Dec 13 to Jan 2 break with all four girls blew past its Oct 15 book-by date. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks only thins from here.

flagged.title: Herskovich wants to stay in touch
flagged.detail: BNP Paribas's Michael Herskovich replied warmly after Toronto, glad to keep in touch as you move toward your next role.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and newsletters: Bloomberg, LinkedIn, Hilton, a few retail sales, and a Cocofloss subscription price-change notice.

acts.line: No meetings on the books anywhere today.

The girls are with Jen tonight, so the evening is quiet and unclaimed.
